title: Coordinate Cartier boundaries in the affine-space tower
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n+1}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, and let $B$ be a $k$-scheme with structure morphism $a_B$. Let $c\in\mathbf N$ and $X=\mathbf A^c_B$ in the ordered iterated-affine-line model [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. For each $i\in\{1,\ldots,c\}$ let $D_i=V(t_i)$ be the scheme-theoretic coordinate zero locus with inclusion $i_i:D_i\hookrightarrow X$. Its ideal is invertible over every base $B$, and the simultaneous coordinate zero section is closed.

Define the ordinary coordinate boundary to be the unique normalized Cartier--Kummer family of [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map] at the explicit annihilating exponent $N=\ell^{n+2}$:
$$i_{i*}A_{D_i}\longrightarrow(\mu_{N,X}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}A)[2].$$
Define its realized coordinate boundary by the exact derived site comparison [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates], precomposed with inverse canonical closed direct-image site exchange and the degree-zero comparison. The resulting pro-etale derived arrow has source $i_{i*}A_{D_i}$ and target the compared shifted finite Tate line `AffineSpacePurity.shiftedLine` of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. Its derived category and coefficient unit are the existing ones of [def-pur-supported-cup]. For $c=0$ the coordinate index is empty and the simultaneous zero section is the identity.
